name: left-directional-drawer
title: Left Directional Drawer
description: A profile-picture editor that slides in from the left when you tap the pencil over a portrait. It offers an initials placeholder, a file picker and a save button.
use: A profile picture needs replacing in place from the page that shows it.
avoid: The chosen file never updates the preview; the JP placeholder is hardcoded.
a11y: The X has no accessible name and the "Profile Picture" label is not tied to the file input. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A portrait photo with a small dark pencil button at its corner; the drawer that slides over it is a dark left panel with an X, a truncated heading and helper line, a rounded square placeholder marked JP, a file input row and a white Save Changes button.
behaves: Tapping the pencil slides the panel in from the left over the dimmed photo; the X or a click outside closes it. The form offers a file field and a Save Changes button.
customise: No props: the portrait URL, initials, copy and file field are written in the file; only the shared drawer takes direction.
weight: light: One panel, one photo and a file input; a tap scale is the only motion.
